THE SLEEPING WHALE IN THE WALL: a great pale whale shape asleep deep in the clear wall, lit from behind so its whole outline glows soft cyan and lies warm across the floor below
THE STAG IN THE ICE: a stag held mid-stride in the clear ice, pale and calm, lit from behind so its antlers and flanks glow and the light reaches across the floor in a warm spread
THE FLIGHT OF BIRDS: a rising line of small birds caught mid-wing inside the clear wall, each one glowing softly from within the ice so the whole line lifts the chamber with pale warm light
THE CURLED FOX: a curled sleeping fox glowing faintly a little way into the clear wall, its tail wrapped close, the soft light coming through the ice and lying gently across the floor
THE SHOAL IN THE WALL: a shoal of small silver fish held in a rising line inside the clear ice, each one lit from behind so the whole shoal glows and washes the near floor with pale silver light

THE GLOW DEEP IN THE WALL: a great mass of pale blue ice buried deep inside the wall with the wall's ice reading above it, below it and on both sides, its chunky stepped sides pulsing softly from within and washing the near ice with a steady blue-white glow
THE WARM GOLD DEEP IN THE ICE: a warm gold light burning far back inside the clear ice, its flat bands of colour stepping toward the viewer through chunky pixel edges and lying gold across the floor
THE ROSE GLOW UNDERFOOT: a soft rose glow deep under the floor ice, coming up through hard pixel edges and flat bands of blush and ivory and spreading warm rose light across the whole chamber floor

THE AMBER GLOW FAR BACK IN THE WALL: a deep amber warmth burning far back inside the wall ice with metres of the wall's own ice in front of it, glowing softly from within so its stepped blocky sides read clearly and warm amber light pours across the ice at your feet
THE SHIP IN THE WALL: a small wooden ship held upright in the clear ice with its mast whole, lit from behind so the hull glows and the light coming through it lies bright across the near floor

THE SLEIGH IN THE ICE: a sleigh held in the clear ice with its runners bright, lit from behind so the whole shape glows warm gold and the light coming through it reaches across the floor in a gentle wash
THE DOOR IN THE ICE: a great plain wooden door standing whole in the clear ice, warm gold light coming around all four of its edges and lying bright in long warm lines across the floor

THE LANTERN IN THE WALL: a lantern still burning inside the clear ice, its chunky stepped sides holding the flame, the light coming through the ice in flat bands of gold and amber and lying warm across the floor
THE STAIR INTO THE BLUE: a stair of ice steps descending into deepening blue with chunky stepped sides, glowing at the bottom so the blue light climbs back up each step and washes the near floor
THE ICE TUNNEL: a tunnel of clear ice running away into the distance, bright at its far turn so the light comes back through chunky stepped walls and lies pale and warm along the near floor

THE ROUND WINDOW IN THE FLOOR: a round window of clear ice set in the floor with hard pixel edges, showing a lit chamber far below so the warm light comes up through it and glows across the surrounding ice

THE ARCHWAY OF CLEAR ICE: an archway of clear ice with warm gold light coming through from the other side, its chunky stepped edges catching the glow and the light spreading wide across the floor beyond

THE LAYERED LIT WALL: a whole wall of ice lit from behind so its flat bands of pale blue and white stack one behind the other, each band glowing, the light coming through evenly and lying bright across the whole near floor

THE THIN WARM PLACE: one thin place in the ice that the warm light comes right through so it glows soft and even, its hard pixel edges bright against the surrounding blue and the warm light washing across the floor in a soft wide spread

THE GREEN AND VIOLET CEILING: green and violet light coming through a thin ceiling of ice with chunky stepped edges and lying across the floor in flat bands of colour so the whole chamber floor glows softly
THE LOW SUN THROUGH THE WALL: low sun coming through a wall of ice in flat bands of gold and rose, turning the near half of the chamber warm and laying long warm light all the way across the floor
THE RISING BUBBLES: a rising line of bubbles caught mid-rise in the clear wall, each one lit from within and glowing so the whole line brightens the wall and the light dapples across the near floor

THE GOLDEN LEAVES: a scattering of golden leaves held at different depths in the clear ice, each one glowing softly from within so warm gold light comes through the wall and lies dappled across the floor

THE FROZEN SNOWFLAKES: a slow fall of snowflakes frozen mid-air in the clear ice, each one catching the light from within and glowing so the whole wall sparkles and pale light ripples across the floor

THE FROZEN WAVE: one frozen wave curled and held in the clear ice, lit from behind along its curled top edge so the light comes through its chunky stepped sides and lies bright and moving across the floor below
